query: I have a 77-year-old man to evaluate: among male Medicare patients aged 72–82 who were transferred from another hospital and had unstable angina as the principal diagnosis at admission with discharge recorded, how many total admissions met these criteria?
final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_admissions
FROM physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions AS adm
JOIN physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients AS pat
  ON adm.subject_id = pat.subject_id
JOIN physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd AS diag
  ON adm.hadm_id = diag.hadm_id
WHERE
  pat.gender = 'M'
  AND pat.anchor_age BETWEEN 72 AND 82
  AND adm.insurance LIKE '%Medicare%'
  AND adm.admission_location = 'TRANSFER FROM ANOTHER HOSPITAL'
  AND diag.seq_num = 1
  AND (
    (diag.icd_version = 9 AND diag.icd_code = '411.1')
    OR
    (diag.icd_version = 10 AND diag.icd_code = 'I20.0')
  )
  AND adm.dischtime IS NOT NULL;
